toleranceEvidence: Eight runs on four GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners (AMD EPYC 7763, 9V45, 9V74; Intel Xeon 6973P), grammar sources identical to dev at f2119a2d0, parseman 0.55.2. Each run's median sat within 0.54% of the pooled median (worst: CSS -0.54%, .jess +0.54%, Less +0.20%, SCSS -0.10%), and the widest spread between one run's two reps was 0.80% (CSS). 1.5% clears both with margin (2.8x and 1.9x), so the gate is not red on an unchanged checkout. Removing the precompiled assembly from the CSS artifact measured +16%, more than ten times the tolerance.
